title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 21 (Authentication of documents, proceedings and contracts)

content.overview: A document or proceeding requiring authentication by a company, or a contract made by or on behalf of a company, may be signed by any key managerial personnel or an officer of the company duly authorised by the Board.
content.glance: Authentication by KMP or Board-authorised officer.
content.study: Section 21 provides that a document or proceeding requiring authentication by a company, or any contract made by or on behalf of a company, may be signed by any key managerial personnel or an officer of the company duly authorised by the Board in this behalf.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.body: Document, proceeding or contract may be signed by KMP or Board-authorised officer.

provisions.title: Authentication of documents, proceedings and contracts
